title: Consumer Mediation Cell Quarterly Report Submission

content.scenario: A consumer mediation cell in Mumbai, attached to the State Commission, fails to submit its quarterly report for the last two quarters. The State Commission issues a notice to the cell, asking for an explanation for the delay.
content.outcome: The consumer mediation cell must submit the quarterly report to the State Commission as per the regulations under sub-section (5) of section 74 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. The cell's failure to do so may result in further action by the State Commission.

user_queries: What is the obligation of a consumer mediation cell regarding quarterly reports?
Can a consumer mediation cell be penalized for not submitting a quarterly report?
What is the role of the State Commission in ensuring consumer mediation cells submit quarterly reports?
